summary: Rotation day: big-caps green (SPX +0.42%, DJI +0.29%) but RUT -0.49% as capital rotated OUT of high-multiple software/cyber (CRWD -5.7%) and biotech (MRNA -10.8%) INTO megacap semis (NVDA +4.0%, META +5.97% on cloud) and financials (fintech, reinsurance surging). VIX -5.11% to 15.03. Iran ceasefire collapsed and Hormuz tankers hit, yet WTI fell -1.22% to $71.51 - markets past peak fear.
